project_info.theme: Graphic social fashion collage built from four fictional brand campaign panels
project_info.creative_direction: Paper-texture poster grid with cutout streetwear models, bold typography, painted shapes, and controlled visual chaos
project_info.color_palette: white, cobalt blue, red, yellow, tan, black, denim gray, and muted neutral paper

main_subject.detail: approved adult models in varied streetwear poses with natural skin and realistic cutout edges
main_subject.wardrobe: technical jacket and black trousers, green-and-yellow track jacket with shorts, brown plaid outerwear, and black-and-white graphic streetwear
main_subject.action: jumping, walking, or leaning poses integrated into four campaign cards

composition_elements.framing: four-panel social poster grid with rounded paper cards, taped collage edges, blue/tan/yellow paint strokes, and cutout figures
composition_elements.campaign_copy: fictional headlines such as ENGINEERED FOR THE NOW, CONTROLLED REBELLION, YOUR MOVE, FREEDOM TO EXPRESS, and LIVE IT LOUD
composition_elements.branding: four invented brand systems with abstract marks only; no Mercedes-Benz, adidas, Burberry, DKNY, social handles, or real logos
composition_elements.footer: generic fictional social icons and a small creator credit placeholder, not real handles

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft commercial daylight at approximately 5200K with directional edge fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: clean cutout shadows, vivid paint contrast, realistic garment texture, and energetic social-campaign polish

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame fashion photography with 35mm lens, composited into printed graphic design
technical_specs.finish: paper creases, restrained grain, crisp fictional typography, natural skin detail, and balanced chaotic layout

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a bold fashion photography collage for social media using four fictional campaign panels on a white paper-texture background. Each rounded card contains an approved clearly adult streetwear model in a dynamic cutout pose: a technical jacket and black trousers, a green-and-yellow track jacket with shorts, brown plaid outerwear, and black-and-white graphic streetwear. Add cobalt blue, red, yellow, and tan painted brush strokes, tape edges, paper creases, and graphic arrows. Use fictional campaign headlines such as ENGINEERED FOR THE NOW, CONTROLLED REBELLION, YOUR MOVE, FREEDOM TO EXPRESS, and LIVE IT LOUD. Build four distinct invented brand systems with abstract marks only; do not include Mercedes-Benz, adidas, Burberry, DKNY, real social handles, platform icons, or real logos. Use soft approximately 5200K commercial daylight, realistic cutout shadows, natural skin and fabric texture, crisp typography, subtle grain, and a chaotic yet balanced editorial layout.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, real brand logo, real social handle, trademark, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed limbs, broken panel grid, illegible text, messy cutout edges
